productsAndServices.description: A barcode-driven fulfillment service for e-commerce that manages receiving, quality control, labeling, picking, packing, storage, last mile delivery, returns, and customer pickups.
productsAndServices.name: Nawel Quick - B2C Fulfillment & Ecommerce Storage Services

productsAndServices.description: A 3PL service offering receiving, quality control, labeling, pallet storage, order preparation, returns management, and middle mile delivery with WMS integration and detailed billing.
productsAndServices.name: Nawel Spaces – B2B/3PL Storage & Distribution Services

productsAndServices.description: A service allowing merchants to drop packages for shipping without storage fees if dispatched within 24 hours, including sorting, same-day delivery, and cash collection from drivers.
productsAndServices.name: Nawel Hubs - Drop & Ship Service

productsAndServices.description: Various storage options including short-term, long-term, dry, ambient, chilled, deep chilled, and frozen storage designed to maintain required product atmospheres.
productsAndServices.name: Storage Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Consulting and technology services to automate warehouses and improve logistics processes, including upgrades from limited-functionality warehouse management systems.
productsAndServices.name: Support Services for Warehouse Automation and Process Streamlining
